title: Getting Started with Dengage Knowledge Base
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://dev.dengage.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

Dengage is a Customer Experience Data Platform (CXDP). It unifies your customer data in one place and lets you act on it: build segments, automate journeys, and reach your customers over email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, in-app, inbox and on-site channels.

This page helps you find the right guide in under a minute.

## Choose your path   [Skip link to Choose your path](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/getting-started\#choose-your-path)

### 🎯 I run campaigns (marketing, CRM, growth)   [Skip link to 🎯 I run campaigns (marketing, CRM, growth)](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/getting-started\#-i-run-campaigns-marketing-crm-growth)

Follow these four steps. They mirror how the platform is organized:

1. **Connect and organize your data.** [Data Management](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/data-management) covers tables, imports, exports, and automated data flows.
2. **Know your audience.** Build dynamic audiences with [Profiles](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/profiles) and [Segments](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/segments), using filters and logic groups.
3. **Create and send.** Design your message under **Content** in the left menu (Email, SMS, Push, and more), then launch it with [Flow Campaigns](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/one-time-flow-campaigns).
4. **Measure and improve.** Track performance under **Analytics**: channel reports, RFM analysis, and audience insights.

### 👩‍💻 I'm integrating (developer)   [Skip link to 👩‍💻 I'm integrating (developer)](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/getting-started\#-im-integrating-developer)

1. Start with [CXDP in a Nutshell](https://dev.dengage.com/reference/general) to see how the APIs, SDKs, and messaging infrastructure fit together.
2. Follow [Onboarding](https://dev.dengage.com/reference/dengage-onboarding) to set up your account, environment, and keys.
3. Install an SDK: [Web](https://dev.dengage.com/reference/web-push-sdk-setup), [iOS](https://dev.dengage.com/reference/ios-sdk-setup), or [Android](https://dev.dengage.com/reference/firebase-sdk-setup). Guides for React Native, Flutter, Cordova, and Expo live in the same section.
4. Call the REST API, starting with [Authorization](https://dev.dengage.com/reference/login).

Prefer watching? The [Walkthrough Videos](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/troubleshoot-guide-videos) offer quick visual overviews of core features.

## Stay up to date   [Skip link to Stay up to date](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/getting-started\#stay-up-to-date)

New features and improvements ship regularly. See [What's New](https://dev.dengage.com/changelog) for release notes.

#### Can't find what you need?   [Skip link to Can't find what you need?](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/getting-started\#cant-find-what-you-need)

Use the **search bar** at the top; it covers every guide, API reference, and FAQ. For quick answers to common questions, check the **FAQ** section in the left menu. Still stuck? Reach out to your Customer Success Manager or our support team.
